description: This file defines the Bloodhound class, a component of the typeahead.js library used for managing and searching datasets, including prefetching and remote data handling.

classes.name: Bloodhound
classes.description: A class for managing datasets with local, remote, and prefetch data sources, providing search and data management functionalities.

methods.name: noConflict
methods.description: Restores previous window.Bloodhound if it exists and returns the Bloodhound class.

methods.name: tokenizers
methods.description: Static property holding tokenizer functions used for data processing.

methods.name: __ttAdapter
methods.description: Internal method for jQuery plugin integration, providing an adapter for asynchronous search.

methods.name: loadPrefetch
methods.description: Loads prefetch data, either from cache or network, and updates the index.

methods.name: initialize
methods.description: Initializes the Bloodhound instance, optionally forcing reinitialization.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves data by IDs from the index.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Performs a search query, handling local and remote data sources.

methods.name: all
methods.description: Returns all data from the index.

methods.name: ttAdapter
methods.description: Deprecated method for jQuery plugin integration, calls __ttAdapter.
